params.name: by_city
params.description: Filter by city name (case-insensitive).

params.name: by_country
params.description: Filter by country name (case-insensitive).

params.name: by_dist
params.description: Filter by geographic distance from a lat,lng point. Format: "lat,lng". Returns results sorted by distance ascending.

params.name: by_ids
params.description: Filter by a comma-separated list of brewery IDs.

params.name: by_name
params.description: Filter by brewery name (case-insensitive partial match).

params.name: by_state
params.description: Filter by state or province name (no abbreviations).

params.name: by_postal
params.description: Filter by postal code (US ZIP codes and international).

params.name: by_type
params.description: Filter by brewery type.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed).

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of breweries per page (default 50, max 200).

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Prefix with "asc:" or "desc:" to control direction. Multiple fields separated by commas.

items.docs: Returns a list of breweries. Supports filtering by city, state, country, type, postal code, name, IDs, and geographic distance. Results are paginated; default page size is 50, maximum is 200. Results can be sorted by one or more fields.

params.name: obdb-id
params.description: The unique Open Brewery DB ID for the brewery.

items.docs: Get full details of a single brewery by its Open Brewery DB ID.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of random breweries to return (default 1, max 50).

items.docs: Returns one or more random brewery records. Use the size parameter to request multiple random breweries at once (max 50).

params.name: query
params.description: Search term to match against brewery names and other text fields.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page (default 50, max 200).

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed).

items.docs: Full-text search across brewery names and other text fields. Returns breweries matching the query term. Results are paginated.

params.name: query
params.description: Search term to match against brewery names.

items.docs: Returns a lightweight list of brewery IDs and names matching the query. Optimized for use in autocomplete/typeahead UI components. Returns up to 15 results.

params.name: by_city
params.description: Scope metadata to breweries in this city.

params.name: by_country
params.description: Scope metadata to breweries in this country.

params.name: by_name
params.description: Scope metadata to breweries matching this name.

params.name: by_state
params.description: Scope metadata to breweries in this state or province.

params.name: by_postal
params.description: Scope metadata to breweries with this postal code.

params.name: by_type
params.description: Scope metadata to breweries of this type.

items.docs: Returns aggregate metadata about the brewery dataset: total count and breakdowns by state/province, country, and brewery type. Accepts the same filter parameters as the list endpoint to scope the metadata to a subset of breweries.
